posts.name: Shrapnyl
posts.cooked:
So not knowing what Openclaw was, I did a search for Automate Games with Openclaw, while this answer from Google and from AI so it might not be accurate, reading it makes me certain I would never install it a computer I wanted to play WOW on, and having this on your computer would likely put your account at risk.

OpenClaw is a highly capable, open-source AI agent framework that can interact with, and operate, computer games. It runs locally, allowing for the automation of tasks such as launching, controlling, and potentially playing games through screen analysis and input simulation.

Key Interactions with Games:

  • Automation: It can be used to automate routine gaming tasks or workflows.
  • Action Execution: As a persistent, local agent, it can execute scripts and control applications, extending this capability to gaming environments.
  • Potential for Autonomous Play: It is designed to act on behalf of users, with possibilities to learn and interact with game interfaces.

posts.cooked: Provided those responses are correct, I’d stay very far away from having it on the same machine you use for WOW.

If you (anyone reading; OP already said they wouldn’t) insist on installing it on your WoW computer, make absolutely sure it isn’t running and nothing from it is left in memory before you start WoW.
